caption:
US visa appointment from Dubai: the official wait is 11.5 months. Appointments in Dubai and Abu Dhabi are open right now.

Most people never check. They hear "impossible" and give up, or they book a slot a year out and hope nothing changes.

As of today the US State Department lists the next available B1/B2 interview at 11.5 months in Dubai and 6 months in Abu Dhabi. Both posts are open and taking applications.

We file for an expedited appointment — and we handle everything the process needs: DS-160 completed, visa fee paid, online account registered, and the expedited request submitted properly.

No hidden fees. One price, agreed in writing.
